showOnlyObtainableRings.description: Define whether you want only the rings obtainable in Jei/Rei to be displayed

showLootTableRings.description: Define whether you want to show the rings that are lootable with Jer/Advanced Loot Info

showWanderingTradesRings.description: Define whether you want to show the rings that are tradable with the wandering trader with Jer/Advanced Loot Info

showCollapsibleRings.description: Define whether you want the rings to be grouped in Rei, this option will activate Collapsible Entries mode for the rings in Rei

increaseLevelInRings.description: Define whether you want to increase the level of the effect when you have the same type of ring

ringsLootTable.description: Define which rings can be found in Loot Chests and their spawn probability

wanderingTraderTrade.description: Define which rings the Wandering Trader can sell, their cost, their spawn probability, and the maximum quantity he can sell
